label: Genuine utility under protection
family: XIII · Privacy / authorship / external receiver experiments

record.category: XIII · Privacy / authorship / external receiver experiments
record.description: Task quality must be measured alongside exposure: a system suppressing all content may be private but unhelpful. Receiver trial must preserve meaningful requested advice, forensic analysis or creative assistance.
record.note: Preregister a useful-task margin. Suppressing all information is an informative control rather than evidence of product success.

review.assessment: Preregister a useful-task margin. Suppressing all information is an informative control rather than evidence of product success.
review.claim_ceiling: Review and proposed experimental conditions; no new empirical acquisition or automatic scientific promotion.
